name: Her Room
source:
Louis and Anna have known each other since they were kids, yet their paths rarely cross. This story begins when Louis chooses to visit her after a long absence.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=51480]Lemmasoft forum[/url]]
translation:
路易斯与安娜自幼相识，人生轨迹却鲜有交集。久别多年之后，路易斯决定登门探望她，故事便由此拉开序幕。

[摘自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=51480]Lemmasoft论坛[/url]]
